What should have been a straightforward transaction became an exhausting and unnecessarily complicated experience due to repeated failures in communication and coordination. As a client, I expected professionalism, transparency, and a genuine commitment to resolving issues. Unfortunately, my experience reflected the exact opposite.

After more than 11 years of working with various brokers and real estate professionals, I can confidently say this has been the most unprofessional, frustrating, and disappointing experience I have encountered. The level of service I received from Clive fell far below the standards one would reasonably expect from a professional real estate agency.

I would strongly encourage anyone considering this agency to carefully evaluate their options before proceeding.

DO NOT TRUST THIS AGENCY WITH YOUR PROPERTY REQUIREMENTS.
